name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale client. Its installer adds a system package and a tailscaled daemon as root, so MiniBox lists it but refuses to install or remove it.
install: t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh -o "$t" && sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh -o "$t" && sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
